# KV Construction

> Remodeling & General Contractor in St. George, UT. Kyle and KV Construction remodel kitchens, bathrooms and whole homes around St. George, and put pet doors where nobody else would. Customers say he answers every call, works with good subs, and leaves no dust behind.

## Services
- Kitchen & bath remodels: Kitchens, dining rooms and bathrooms updated with top-rated materials.
- Pet doors: Dog and cat doors installed through walls and doors, even in tricky spots.
- Repairs & water damage: Damage from leaks and neglect fixed, with engineering when it's needed.
- Doors, floors & fireplaces: Sliding doors, wood floors, tile, fireplaces and accent walls.

## Service area
- St. George, UT

## Questions customers ask
- **Can you put a pet door through a wall?** Yes. Many customers had dog and cat doors installed through walls, even where there wasn't an ideal place for one.
- **Do you remodel kitchens and bathrooms?** Yes. One customer had their entire kitchen and dining room updated. Another had a kitchen and 8 bathrooms remodeled in 2 phases.
- **Can you fix serious water damage?** Yes. One customer had major water damage in a basement, and Kyle arranged engineering to replace the supports safely.
- **Do you work with subcontractors?** Yes. Customers say Kyle is well connected with subs and keeps them organized.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve St. George and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
